# What should you charge to clear this house?

> Free hoarding and heavy-clutter cleanout bid calculator: enter floor area, how full the space is, crew, containers and dump fees, and get a price, the days and containers needed, a change-order rate per cubic yard and how far the volume can overrun. Runs in your browser.

Free and open source (MIT). Results are estimates from the numbers typed in, not legal, tax, financial or professional advice.
